method:
select round(sum(seats*unit_price_minor*(1-discount_pct)/power(10,minor_unit_exponent)*usd_per_unit/case when billing_interval='year' then 12 else 1 end),2) mrr from marts.fct_subscription_months s join marts.dim_accounts a using(account_id) where month_end='2025-06-30' and s.status in ('active','past_due') and not a.is_internal
-- Assumptions: MRR = seats x unit price x (1 - discount), annual plans /12, converted to USD at the month-end rate in the table. Counts active and past_due subscriptions (past_due = 30488.64 of the total; active only = 4149430.98). Excludes canceled subscriptions and internal accounts (internal active would add 477844.26). No deleted accounts had live subscriptions.

./query "select round(sum(f.seats*f.unit_price_minor*(1-f.discount_pct)*f.usd_per_unit/power(10,f.minor_unit_exponent)/(case when f.billing_interval='year' then 12 else 1 end)),2) as mrr_usd from marts.fct_subscription_months f join marts.dim_accounts a using(account_id) where f.month_end='2025-06-30' and f.status='active' and not a.is_internal"

./query "select round(sum(seats*unit_price_minor*(1-discount_pct)*(case when billing_interval='month' then 12 else 1 end)/power(10,minor_unit_exponent)*usd_per_unit),2) arr from marts.fct_subscription_months s join marts.dim_accounts a using(account_id) where month_end='2024-12-31' and s.status in ('active','past_due') and not a.is_internal"

No ARR metric is defined in the semantic layer (only an `mrr` measure, no metrics), and ./mf failed because the semantic manifest artifact is missing, so this is derived with SQL rather than from an official definition. The `mrr` measure's expr also disagrees with its own description (ignores discount, status and JPY's zero-decimal minor units), so I followed the description rather than the expr.

./query "select sum(s.seats * s.unit_price_minor / power(10, s.minor_unit_exponent) * (1 - s.discount_pct) * s.usd_per_unit * (case when s.billing_interval = 'year' then 1 else 12 end)) as arr from marts.fct_subscription_months s join marts.dim_accounts a using (account_id) where s.month_end = '2024-12-31' and s.status = 'active' and not a.is_internal"

Assumptions: ARR = MRR x 12 on the 2024-12-31 snapshot; status = 'active' only (trialing, canceled, past_due excluded); discount applied (discount_pct is a fraction); converted to USD at the row's rate using each currency's minor-unit exponent; internal accounts excluded; accounts later deleted are kept because all their deletions happened after 2024-12-31. Sensitivity: including internal accounts gives 44180606.02; also counting past_due gives 40075388.53; dropping later-deleted accounts gives 39590397.13.

./query "select count(distinct s.account_id) from marts.fct_subscription_months s join marts.dim_accounts a using(account_id) where s.month_end='2025-03-31' and s.status='active' and not a.is_internal"

./mf could not run (semantic manifest missing; metrics.yml defines no metrics), so I applied the semantic layer's measure definitions (active_customers / paying_subscriptions: distinct accounts with status='active') in SQL, excluding internal Relay QA/Demo/Sandbox accounts:

./query "select count(distinct s.account_id) from marts.fct_subscription_months s join marts.dim_accounts a using(account_id) where s.month_end='2025-03-31' and s.status='active' and not a.is_internal"

Notes: trialing (29), past_due (6) and canceled subscriptions are not counted. Including the 43 internal accounts gives 1178. The 6 accounts later deleted (Apr-Jun 2025) are kept since they were active at 2025-03-31; dropping them gives 1129.

./query "with m as (select s.account_id, seats*unit_price_minor/power(10,minor_unit_exponent)*(1-discount_pct)*usd_per_unit/(case when s.billing_interval='year' then 12 else 1 end) mrr from marts.fct_subscription_months s join marts.dim_accounts a using(account_id) where month_end='2025-06-30' and s.status in ('active','past_due') and not a.is_internal and not coalesce(a.is_deleted,false)) select sum(mrr)/count(distinct account_id) from m" -- ARPA = total MRR in USD (seats x unit price x (1-discount), annual plans /12, converted at month-end FX) divided by distinct paying accounts (1192); active + past_due subscriptions, internal and deleted accounts excluded. MRR 4179919.61 / 1192 accounts = 3506.64. Active-only variant would be 3501.63.

./mf query --metrics arpa,mrr,paying_customers --group-by metric_time__month --start-time 2025-05-01 --end-time 2025-07-31 (official arpa metric = mrr / paying_customers; June 2025 row: 4179919.61 / 1192 = 3506.6439704356076)
./mf query --metrics arpa,mrr,paying_customers --group-by metric_time__month --start-time 2025-05-01 --end-time 2025-07-31  (June 2025 row: MRR 4179919.61 / 1150 paying customers = 3634.712706747169)

select sum(seats * unit_price_minor / power(10, minor_unit_exponent) * (1 - discount_pct) * usd_per_unit / (case when billing_interval='year' then 12 else 1 end)) / count(distinct s.account_id) as arpa from marts.fct_subscription_months s join marts.dim_accounts a using (account_id) where s.month_end = '2025-06-30' and s.status = 'active' and not a.is_internal and not a.is_deleted

./query "with a as (select distinct account_id from marts.fct_subscription_months where month_end='2025-04-30' and status in ('active','past_due')), m as (select distinct account_id from marts.fct_subscription_months where month_end='2025-05-31' and status in ('active','past_due')) select count(*) from a join marts.dim_accounts d using(account_id) where a.account_id not in (select account_id from m) and not d.is_internal and not d.is_deleted" -- Churned = account had an active/past_due subscription at 2025-04-30 month-end and none at 2025-05-31; internal and soft-deleted accounts excluded. Returns 33. Including the 2 soft-deleted accounts (ACC-00276, ACC-00421, both deleted in May 2025 after being active in April) gives 35; no internal accounts were among the churned.

./mf could not load the semantic manifest (no metric is actually defined for churn; only a churned_customers measure in the churn_metrics helper model, which is not materialized in the warehouse). So I replicated the semantic layer's churn_metrics.sql logic in SQL: an account churns in a month if it had an active subscription the prior month and none this month.

./query "with ms as (select account_id, month_end, max(case when status='active' then 1 else 0 end) a from marts.fct_subscription_months group by 1,2), l as (select *, lag(a) over (partition by account_id order by month_end) pa from ms) select count(distinct account_id) from l where pa=1 and a=0 and month_end='2025-05-31'"

Result: 35 (same result if past_due is treated as still active).

with s as (select coalesce(a.parent_account_id,m.account_id) logo, month_end from marts.fct_subscription_months m join marts.dim_accounts a using(account_id) where month_end in ('2025-03-31','2025-04-30') and status in ('active','past_due') and not a.is_internal and not a.is_deleted group by all) select count(*) start_logos, count(*) filter (where c.logo is null) churned, count(*) filter (where c.logo is null)*1.0/count(*) rate from (select * from s where month_end='2025-03-31') p left join (select * from s where month_end='2025-04-30') c using(logo) -- 29 churned / 1093 starting logos = 0.026532. Definition assumed (no documented one in the warehouse): logo = parent-level account, paying = active or past_due subscription at month end, internal and soft-deleted accounts excluded. Alternatives: including deleted accounts 30/1099 = 0.0273; account-level without parent rollup 30/1135 = 0.0264.

./query "with m as (select distinct account_id from marts.fct_subscription_months where month_end='2025-03-31' and status='active'), a as (select distinct account_id from marts.fct_subscription_months where month_end='2025-04-30' and status='active') select count(*) start_active, count(*) filter (where account_id not in (select account_id from a)) churned, churned * 1.0 / start_active as logo_churn_rate from m" -- 31 churned / 1178 active at start of April 2025. ./mf could not be used (semantic manifest missing; no logo churn rate metric defined), so this follows the churn_metrics helper model logic from the semantic layer.

./query "select round(sum((subtotal_minor-discount_minor)/power(10,minor_unit_exponent)*usd_per_unit),2) billings from marts.fct_invoices f join marts.dim_accounts a using(account_id) where issued_date>='2025-01-01' and issued_date<'2025-04-01' and f.status not in ('draft','void') and not a.is_internal" -- Billings = invoiced amount net of discounts, excluding tax, converted to USD at each invoice's rate; invoices issued 2025-01-01..2025-03-31; draft and void invoices excluded (paid + uncollectible kept); internal accounts excluded; credit notes not deducted. Alternatives: including tax = 14051246.74; including internal accounts (ex-tax) = 14647872.95.

./query "select sum((i.subtotal_minor - i.discount_minor) * i.usd_per_unit / power(10, i.minor_unit_exponent)) from marts.fct_invoices i join marts.dim_accounts a using (account_id) where i.issued_date >= '2025-01-01' and i.issued_date < '2025-04-01' and i.status not in ('draft','void') and not a.is_internal"

Notes: ./mf could not load its semantic manifest and metrics.yml defines no metrics, so this follows the semantic layer's `billings` measure on invoices (net of discounts, USD, by issued_date) computed in SQL, with three adjustments that are my judgment calls: (1) divided by each currency's minor_unit_exponent instead of a fixed 100, because JPY has exponent 0 and the measure as written understates JPY invoices 100x; (2) excluded draft and void invoices; (3) excluded internal accounts (42 invoices, 1788021.18). Alternatives: including internal accounts = 14647872.95; the measure exactly as written, all statuses and accounts, /100 = 14608826.30.

./query "select sum((i.subtotal_minor - i.discount_minor)/power(10,i.minor_unit_exponent)*i.usd_per_unit) from marts.fct_invoices i join marts.dim_date d on d.date_day = i.issued_date join marts.dim_accounts a using (account_id) where d.fiscal_year = 2025 and i.status not in ('draft','void') and not a.is_internal" -- FY2025 = 2024-02-01 to 2025-01-31; billings = invoiced amount net of discounts, excluding tax, converted to USD; draft/void invoices and internal accounts excluded; credit notes (416320.59 USD) not deducted. Alternatives: including tax 43650625.67; including internal accounts (net of tax) 44729507.03.

./mf query --metrics billings --start-time 2024-02-01 --end-time 2025-01-31  (FY2025 = 2024-02-01 to 2025-01-31 per marts.dim_date fiscal calendar; cross-checked with SQL joining fct_invoices to dim_accounts and dim_date where fiscal_year = 2025)
./mf query --metrics billings --start-time 2024-02-01 --end-time 2025-01-31  (fiscal year 2025 = 2024-02-01 through 2025-01-31 per marts.dim_date)

./query "select sum((subtotal_minor - discount_minor) / power(10, minor_unit_exponent) * usd_per_unit) from marts.fct_invoices i join marts.dim_date d on d.date_day = i.issued_date where d.fiscal_year = 2025 and i.status not in ('draft','void')"  -- ./mf was unusable (no semantic manifest, no metrics defined), so the semantic-layer 'billings' measure (subtotal - discount, in USD, by issued_date) was applied in SQL with two deviations: (1) minor units divided by 10^minor_unit_exponent rather than a hard-coded 100, since JPY invoices have exponent 0; (2) draft and void invoices excluded. FY2025 = 2024-02-01 to 2025-01-31 per dim_date. Alternatives: all statuses incl. draft/void = 46435149.63; literal YAML formula (/100, all statuses) = 42542759.97.

./mf query --metrics billings --start-time 2024-02-01 --end-time 2025-01-31  (fiscal year 2025 = 2024-02-01 to 2025-01-31 per marts.dim_date; cross-checked with: select sum(billed_usd) from marts.sem_invoices where issued_date between '2024-02-01' and '2025-01-31')

./mf query --metrics billings --group-by metric_time__fiscal_year  (FY2025 row = 2024-02-01..2025-01-31; cross-checked with ./mf query --metrics billings --start-time 2024-02-01 --end-time 2025-01-31)

./query "select round(sum(recognized_amount_minor/power(10,r.minor_unit_exponent)*r.usd_per_unit),2) usd from marts.fct_revenue_recognition r join marts.dim_accounts a using(account_id) where recognized_month='2025-03-01' and r.status not in ('draft','void') and not a.is_internal"

./mf could not be used (semantic manifest fails to load and metrics.yml defines no metrics), so computed in SQL from the recognized_revenue measure definition, with corrections: ./query "select sum(recognized_amount_minor*usd_per_unit/power(10,minor_unit_exponent)) from marts.fct_revenue_recognition r join marts.dim_accounts a using(account_id) where recognized_month='2025-03-01' and r.status not in ('draft','void') and not a.is_internal". Assumptions: (1) divided by 10^minor_unit_exponent instead of the measure's hard-coded /100, since JPY has exponent 0; (2) excluded draft and void invoices, kept paid and uncollectible; (3) excluded internal accounts (is_internal); (4) amounts are net of discounts, exclude tax, and credit notes are not netted out. For reference, the semantic layer measure as literally written (all statuses, all accounts, /100) gives 4104435.36.
